versions.changelog:
Initial release of BP Log Sentinel skill.

- Enables consult-grade analysis of home blood pressure logs.
- Calculates AHA 7-day home average, excluding day 1 per guidelines.
- Categorizes BP using ACC/AHA 2017 and ESC/ESH 2023 thresholds.
- Detects white-coat and masked hypertension patterns when a clinic value is provided.
- Flags measurement technique errors by analyzing free-text notes.
- Generates a summary suitable for sharing with healthcare professionals.
